title: Pecorino Fritters with Honey Glaze
description: A sweet and savory Italian-inspired dessert where crispy fritters are drizzled in a sweet honey glaze. The nutty notes of pecorino add a depth of flavor to the airy fritters.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
2. In a bowl, mix together the pecorino, flour, and egg until well combined.
3. Drop spoonfuls of the mixture into the hot oil.
4. Fry the fritters until they are golden brown and crispy.
5. Remove the fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
6. In a small saucepan, heat the honey and caramel sauce over low heat.
7. Drizzle the honey glaze over the fritters.
8. Sprinkle with stir-fry spices before serving.
